## Checklist

- [ ] I added one entry to `catalog.json` (alphabetical by id) and nothing else
- [ ] The extension's source code lives in its own repository, not in this one
- [ ] The package link downloads a `.rkqlx` whose `package.json` has this id
- [ ] The source code is public, under an open-source licence
- [ ] The permissions the extension asks for are described in its README, with the reason for each
- [ ] The extension collects no data beyond what its README says
- [ ] I read the [listing rules](../README.md#what-gets-listed)
